subject: allele frequency per snp per pop

messages.author: 150ce2183f5a7bed
messages.subject: allele frequency per snp per pop
parts:
Hi

I found this gl.alf() function in dartR very useful in calculating frequency of both alleles in each snp for every individual. However I need to calculate this metric per population (frequency of first and second allele per population).

I appreciate if anyone help me in this regard.

Many thanks,

Far

messages.author: b3d929c6746ca81a
messages.subject: Re: [dartR] allele frequency per snp per pop
parts:
pops <- seppop(gl)

res <- lapply(pops, gl.alf)

res

should work
cheers, Bernd
